_note: Captions for the Store screenshots. Check them against README.md before every run: they must describe what the app does now.

headline: Flick to coast.
Click to stop.
shots.body: Flick the wheel and the page keeps gliding. Roll again to speed up or slow down. A click stops it.

headline: Make it yours.
shots.body: Set the distance, glide and acceleration, and how coasting feels. Give any app its own speed, or turn smoothing off for it.

headline: Quietly in the tray.
shots.body: Screzy runs in the background and smooths the wheel in every app. Switch it off and on, or open Preferences, from the tray icon.

headline: Rules for each app.
shots.body: Pick from the apps that are running, then give one its own scroll distance, or turn smoothing off for it, such as a game.
